name: uv
description: Redirects pip to uv as a hook. Refuses a Bash command that runs pip install or pip uninstall, whether spelled pip, pip3.12, .venv/bin/pip or python -m pip, behind VAR=value, sudo, env or xargs, anywhere in a compound command or backtick substitution. Read-only pip subcommands, uv pip, pipx, pipenv and pip mentioned inside quotes or a heredoc all pass, so a command hidden inside bash -c or a quoted $(...) is not seen. The refusal names uv add or uv remove inside a uv project and uv pip outside one. Requires jq.
